purpose: Implementation task packets, not authorization to run external tools or modify a remote repository.

tasks.title: Reconcile checkout and lock decisions
deliverables: Read current policies and validate source anchors against reviewed commit.
Create next-free ADR and baseline reconciliation.
acceptance: No unreviewed version assumptions.
No repository policy or API changes hidden in scope.

tasks.title: Implement typed model, identities and bundle validation
deliverables: Rust model and exact canonical hashing.
Schema validation and cross-reference/ontology validator.
acceptance: All identity vectors pass.
Reject floats, malformed paths, foreign references and immutable-ID collisions.

tasks.title: Implement transactional SQLite storage
deliverables: Migrations and one-writer store.
Atomic staged publication, idempotent ingestion and run diagnostics.
acceptance: Interrupted import invisible to readers.
Foreign keys and published-state checks pass.
Conflicting immutable records rejected.

tasks.title: Implement contexts, policy and evidence retrieval
deliverables: Pinned context creation and aliases.
Policy-aware evidence resolution with verified bytes.
Append-only review and conflict records.
acceptance: No cross-build leakage or current-main fetch.
Privacy closure and Unicode source spans tested.
Hypotheses excluded unless selected.

tasks.title: Implement indexed search and bounded traversal
deliverables: FTS and typed adjacency query service.
Node, neighbors, coverage and common JSON response.
acceptance: Deterministic result order and cursors.
High-fan-out limits and source filtering.
No hidden identifiers in counts or snippets.

tasks.title: Implement source and SCIP import
deliverables: Mudcrab Rust SCIP import, structural source fallback.
External/local symbols, occurrence roles, encodings and dependency provenance.
acceptance: Index actual checkout.
SCIP reference never automatically becomes call.
Feature/target coverage and unresolved symbols reported.

tasks.title: Index community sources, docs and Bevy WGSL
deliverables: Opt-in local source registry.
C/C++ structural or SCIP adapters, Markdown and Bevy shader declarations.
Version/lineage metadata and material source seeds.
acceptance: No regex-based guessed ABI layout.
Imported names retain origin.
Bevy preprocessor placeholders not reported as numeric bindings.

tasks.title: Add read-only converter research export
deliverables: Converter kg-export bin and bounded DTO helper.
Original parsed NIF fields and interpreted material contracts with diagnostics.
acceptance: Reuse existing parser/inspect_nif_materials.
Resilient fallback not reported as authored raw field.
No input/output mutation; unchanged conversion behavior.

tasks.title: Import actual GLB and conversion lineage
deliverables: Final GLB JSON pointers and material/texture bindings.
Manifest hash/config/pruned-reference relationships.
Separate raw, interpreted and emitted stages.
acceptance: Two shapes and duplicate names join correctly.
Absent extension never implies zero flags.
sRGB aliases, clamps and pruning retained.

tasks.title: Deliver actual materials cross-layer trace
deliverables: Trace material/concept implementations.
Repo source selectors for double-sided, texture slots and glossiness.
Actual synthetic NIF generation/conversion trace.
acceptance: Q01-Q03 supported with exact citations.
Unknown runtime consumer reported as unresolved.
No hard-coded demonstration-only node IDs.

tasks.title: Implement bounded Ghidra/PyGhidra export
deliverables: Read-only exporter at levels 0/1/2.
Types/signatures/import lineage, direct/indirect calls, selected P-code.
Original native toy fixture and smoke instructions.
acceptance: Actual toy program export where tool available.
Limits, decompile timeouts and renamed analysis snapshot tested.
No mutations or automatic aggregate tool execution.

tasks.title: Implement RenderDoc and runtime-observation import
deliverables: Existing-capture exporter for selected events/resources/reflection.
Generic debugger/DevBench observation envelope with loaded-module identity.
acceptance: Capture-local resource IDs do not merge.
Heap addresses not normalized as RVAs.
Replay availability separate from import success.
Asset/native-to-GPU mapping remains candidate without evidence.

tasks.title: Implement context packets, proposals and review CLI
deliverables: Bounded context packets and proposal import.
Explicit review command and conflict surfacing.
acceptance: Q04-Q10 return evidence or explicit missing-stage status.
64KiB default packet bound.
No model credentials or unrequested tool execution.

tasks.title: Expose read-only MCP over shared query service
deliverables: Seven typed MCP tools using rmcp stdio.
Fixed context/policy, tool annotations and diagnostics routing.
acceptance: CLI/MCP output equivalence.
Unknown tools, arbitrary SQL/path input and policy escalation rejected.
Restricted launch acknowledgement enforced.

tasks.title: Implement incremental imports and safe public export
deliverables: Fingerprint invalidation and historical snapshot retention.
New-destination policy-filtered export with rebuilt FTS and artifact closure.
acceptance: Stale contexts/cursors behave explicitly.
Private markers absent from files, indexes and diagnostics.
No sharing working database or WAL after row deletion.

tasks.title: Complete integration, documentation and measured checks
deliverables: All query demonstrations and package-level tests.
Actual source + synthetic conversion + external-tool smoke reports.
Documented quick start, performance report, source scope and missing prerequisites.
acceptance: Current repository fmt/clippy/nextest gates.
Graph core dependency independence.
No stubs-only adapters or original-game parity claims.
